# AstryxToken { #anylumino.AstryxToken }

```python
AstryxToken(label, *, color='default', **props)
```

Render an Astryx token or chip.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name    | Type   | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      | Default     |
|---------|--------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-------------|
| label   | str    | Visible or accessible label for the component.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   | _required_  |
| color   | str    | Astryx component option.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | `'default'` |
| **props | Any    | JSON-safe Token props. Useful keys: size, isDisabled, clickable, onRemove, href, description, isLabelHidden, className, and style. Pass ``onRemove=True`` to emit remove clicks. Upstream icon and endContent props expect React nodes and are not adapted by the Python bridge. The color prop supports default, red, orange, yellow, green, teal, cyan, blue, purple, pink, and gray. See Astryx component docs: <https://astryx.atmeta.com/components/Token>. | `{}`        |
